ترتعفي (form VIII)
# تَرْتَعِفِي (tartaʕifī) /tar.ta.ʕi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# تُرْتَعَفِي (turtaʕafī) /tur.ta.ʕa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
